definition: to go in; to enter into.
example_en: The cat entered through the gap in the door.

definition: an enemy; a hostile person.
example_en: News spread that an enemy had come to the town.

definition: a fraud; a deception; cheating.
example_en: The merchant's fraud came to light.

definition: to become temporarily unconscious.
example_en: As soon as he got hit, he became unconscious.

definition: the part of the arm between the elbow and the wrist; the fore-arm.
example_en: The doctor bandaged his forearm.

definition: rays of heat; hot rays (as of the sun).
example_en: The summer's hot rays heated the earth.

definition: the act of throbbing; pulsation.
example_en: Her heartbeat increased with fear.

definition: one's wife's younger brother.
example_en: The wife's younger brother used to visit his sister's house often.

definition: a thing achieved, esp. by skill, work, courage, etc.; achievement.
example_en: That sculptor's achievement is very famous.

definition: to suffer pain; to undergo affliction; to be persecuted.
example_en: People suffered great affliction during the famine.

definition: muddy, dirty water.
example_en: The drain's muddy water flowed onto the road.

definition: tongs or pincers for grasping, compressing, and pulling, used esp. by surgeons and dentists; forceps.
example_en: The doctor pulled out the thorn with the forceps.

definition: a climbing up, as mounting on the back of a horse, elephant etc.
example: ಆನೆಯ ಮೇಲಿನ ಏರಾಟ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಕುತೂಹಲ ಮೂಡಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The climbing onto the elephant's back roused everyone's curiosity.

definition: any of the shrubby plants as Coffea arabica, coffea robusta etc. of Rubiaceae family.
example_en: The farmer grew coffee on the hill slope.

definition: a floor that is levelled, hardened and covered with a layer of cement concrete.
example_en: They had a cement concrete floor laid in front of the house.

definition: the hair on the head.
example_en: Her head-hair was long and shining.

definition: the Sun-God.
example_en: The Sun-God shines in the sky.

definition: a river or stream.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ನಿಮ್ನಗೆ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A river was flowing near that village.

definition: to have or be painted with different colours.
example_en: The painter colored the cloth so it was painted with different colors.

definition: a brief statement or summary of accounts; an abstract.
example_en: The accountant wrote down the month's abstract of accounts.

definition: to obey a command order.
example_en: The soldiers obeyed the commander's order.

definition: one million; 10,00,000.
example_en: The population of that country crossed one million.

definition: (astrol.) the star that is ruling at the time of one's birth, which determines the zodiac sign which that persons belongs to.
example_en: The astrologer calculated the star ruling at her birth.

definition: a deceptive, deceitful man; a trickster.
example: ಆ ಹೂಟಗಾರ ಜನರನ್ನು ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸಿ ಹಣ ಕದ್ದನು.
example_en: That trickster deceived people and stole money.

definition: to see; to look at; to observe.
example_en: He observed that scene from a distance.

definition: to rub, knead, etc. a part of the body, usu. with the hands, to stimulate circulation and make muscles or joints supple, relieve tension, etc.; to massage.
example_en: Grandmother massaged her grandson's back.

definition: a man who guards at the door of a building; a door-keeper.
example_en: The doorkeeper stood guard at the door all night.

definition: the plant Musa paradisiaca of Musaceae family.
example_en: They spread banana leaves for the meal.

definition: the cultivated produce of the ground, while growing; crop.
example_en: The crop is growing green in the field.

definition: to hit at the target (without fail).
example_en: The archer hit the target without fail and amazed everyone.

definition: one time, occasion only; once.
example_en: I once went to that town.

definition: the plant Asparagus falcatus of Liliaceae family.
example: ಅಜ್ಜ ಆಹೇರು ಗಿಡದ ಬೇರನ್ನು ಔಷಧಿಗೆ ಬಳಸಿದರು.
example_en: Grandfather used the root of the aheru plant as medicine.

definition: (dance.) one of the one hundred and eight coordinated movements of hands and legs.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ನಾಗಾಪಸರ್ಪಿತ ಎಂಬ ನೃತ್ಯಚಲನೆಯನ್ನು ಶಿಷ್ಯರಿಗೆ ಕಲಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The teacher taught the disciples the dance movement called nāgāpasarpita.

definition: a female singer.
example_en: The female singer was famous in the royal court.

definition: the year that has just gone by; the previous year.
example: ಗತಾಬ್ಧದ ಬೆಳೆಗಿಂತ ಈ ವರ್ಷದ ಬೆಳೆ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This year's crop is better than last year's crop.

definition: a weapon consisting of a long shaft, with a pointed end, used for throwing at or stabbing; a spear.
example_en: A spear was found in the old fort.

definition: the quality or the fact of the body being corpulent and fleshy; obesity.
example_en: Obesity increased due to excessive food intake.

definition: a live person; the soul that has a physical body.
example: ಆತ್ಮಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇಕಿದ್ದಾಗ ದೇಹಧಾರಿಯಾಗಿ ಹುಟ್ಟುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They say the soul takes birth as an embodied being when needed.

definition: a knot tied to hold the sari (sire,a garment worn by Hindu women, consisting of a long piece of cotton or silk wrapped around the body with one end draped over the head or over one shoulder) at the waist.
example_en: She tied the sari's waist-knot tightly.

definition: having weight; hard to lift or move because of great weight; weighty.
example_en: This iron box is very heavy.

definition: a charitable institution or organisation.
example_en: That charitable institution gives food to the poor.

definition: to prepare the warp (for weaving).
example_en: She prepared the warp to weave the cloth.

definition: a small village.
example_en: There is a small village on the riverbank.

definition: a small shell-less mollusc of the class Gastropoda often destructive to plants; a slug.
example_en: A slug was seen in the garden during the rainy season.

definition: a poem, properly expressive of a single, complete thought, idea or sentiment, consisting of fourteen lines; a sonnet.
example: ಕವಿ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಸುಂದರ ಸಾನೆಟ್ಟು ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: The poet wrote a beautiful sonnet in English.

definition: lacking wisdom; unintelligent.
example_en: The unintelligent student wrote nothing in the examination.

definition: a round stick, of approx. one and half feet in length used to play the game cinnikōlu.
example_en: The boys played holding the cinni stick.

definition: the Buddhist religious path.
example_en: Buddhist monks follow the Buddhist religious path.

definition: a small piece taken out from a whole fruit, as for testing.
example_en: She tasted a sample piece of the fruit at the market.

definition: the state of being perfectly united with the Ultimate and Supreme Principle.
example_en: The seeker attained knowledge of the tattva (union with the Supreme).

definition: midway - a) the middle of the way or distance b) a middle way or course.
example_en: They took rest midway along the road.

definition: a beautiful, charming woman; a belle.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಅವಳು ಅಂದಗಾತಿ ಎಂದೇ ಪ್ರಸಿದ್ಧಳಾಗಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: In that town, she was famous as the beautiful belle.

definition: a steep water fall; a cascade.
example: ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ದಬದಬೆಯ ನೀರು ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಧುಮುಕುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The water of that mountain's cascade falls down forcefully.

definition: a printed stamp or an embossed label to show that the postal charge has been paid; a postage-stamp.
example_en: He stuck a postage-stamp on the letter and sent it.

definition: two different types of personalities (found in a single person).
example_en: The doctor identified dual personality in him.

definition: a particular kind of military array.
example_en: The commander formed the garbhavyuha military array in the battle.

definition: (pl.) two halves; the two halves of a whole.
example_en: They cut the fruit and made it into two halves.

definition: a small hill; a mound; a hillock.
example: ಊರ ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಪೋರೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small hillock outside the village.

definition: the annual herb Coriandrum sativum of Umbellifarae family; coriander.
example_en: They added coriander leaves to the sambar.

definition: extreme heat.
example_en: The kitchen became hot due to the extreme heat of the stove.

definition: to become agitated or irritated.
example_en: Hearing that news, the people became agitated.

definition: a folk god.
example_en: The villagers offered worship to the folk god Huli Deva.

definition: good clothing.
example_en: They brought good clothing for the bride.

definition: a man who kills, slaughters; a killer, murderer; a slaughterer.
example_en: The police arrested that murderer.

definition: to be separated, severed.
example_en: The two groups became separated due to the quarrel.

definition: a sweet, crystalline substance, obtained chiefly from the juice of the sugarcane and the sugar beet, used extensively for sweetening foods and beverages; sugar.
example_en: He put sugar in the tea.

definition: the splendid red or reddish light refracted at the time of sun-rise.
example_en: The splendid red light of sunrise spread across the sky and the birds chirped.

definition: the tanned skin of a tiger.
example_en: The hunter hung the tanned tiger-skin on the wall.

definition: a brave, daring or adventurous woman.
example_en: That daring woman hunted alone in the forest.

definition: a vine-drinking cup; a vine-glass.
example_en: He served the wine in the wine-cup.

definition: provided with what all is needed; well-equipped.
example_en: The well-equipped army moved to the border.

definition: the act or an instance of breaking.
example: ಗಾಜಿನ ಒಡೆತದ ಶಬ್ದ ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಹೆದರಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone was frightened hearing the sound of the glass breaking.

definition: a stone-ware.
example_en: They had arranged stone-ware in the kitchen.

definition: to shiver, tremble (as from fear).
example_en: Hearing the lion's roar, the child trembled with fear.

definition: the act, manner, function or power of government; governance.
example_en: The country's governance needs to improve.

definition: mischievous - a) causing mischief; b) inclined to annoy or vex with playful tricks; naughty:.
example: ಆ ತುಂಟ ಹುಡುಗ ಯಾವಾಗಲೂ ತಂಟೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ.
example_en: That naughty boy always causes mischief.

definition: to feed - a) to give food (liquid or solid); b) to furnish something essential for the growth, sustenance, maintenance etc.
example_en: The mother fed milk to the child.

definition: the ability to use both the hands with same ease and dexterity; ambidexterity.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಇಚ್ಚಾರಿ ಇದ್ದುದರಿಂದ ಎರಡೂ ಕೈಗಳಿಂದ ಬರೆಯಬಲ್ಲನು.
example_en: Since he had ambidexterity, he could write with both hands.

definition: the upper portion.
example_en: There is a room in the upper portion of the house.

definition: the main wooden beam that connects the yoking point of a cart to its axle.
example: ಎತ್ತಿನ ಗಾಡಿಯ ತೋಳುಮರ ಮುರಿದು ಗಾಡಿ ನಿಂತಿತು.
example_en: The cart's connecting beam broke and the cart stopped.

definition: the act or process of driving an evil spirit out or away by incantations and other rituals; exorcism.
example_en: They performed an exorcism in the village and cured the patient.

definition: any of various free-swimming, mostly marine invertibrates, esp. of Scyphozoa class, having long, hanging tentacles with stinging cells on them, and the a body made up largely of jellylike substance and shaped like an umbrella; jelly-fish.
example_en: A jellyfish was floating on the water in the sea.

definition: a gratifying one's sexual desire with a person of the same sex as oneself; homosexuality.
example: ಆ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಲಿಂಗಕಾಮದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚರ್ಚೆ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: A discussion about homosexuality took place in that society.

definition: if possible.
example_en: If possible, I will come and meet tomorrow.

definition: to be enchanted, fascinated or charmed by; to be enamoured.
example_en: He was enchanted by her beauty.

definition: the vaporous matter arising from something burning and made visible by minute particles of carbon suspended in it; smoke.
example: ಒಲೆಯಿಂದ ಎದ್ದ ಹೊಗೆ ಮನೆಯ ತುಂಬಾ ಹರಡಿತು.
example_en: The smoke rising from the stove spread through the house.

definition: a delusive sentimental attachment.
example: ಅವನ ಅೞಿಮೋಹ ಕೊನೆಗೆ ಅವನಿಗೇ ದುಃಖ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: His delusive sentimental attachment eventually brought him sorrow.

definition: Śiva.
example_en: Śivāramaṇa's (Śiva's) temple is on the hill.

definition: a military projectile used in ancient warfare to hurl heavy objects against the defensive wall of the fortified place of one's enemy.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಯುದ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಶತ್ರುಗಳು ಕೋಟೆಯ ಗೋಡೆಗೆ ಢೇಂಕಣೆಯನ್ನು ಎಸೆದರು.
example_en: In ancient warfare the enemies hurled a projectile at the fort wall.

definition: distant in space; far off; far away; remote.
example: ಆ ಆರಾತೀಯ ಪ್ರದೇಶಕ್ಕೆ ತಲುಪಲು ಎರಡು ದಿನ ಬೇಕಾಯಿತು.
example_en: It took two days to reach that remote/far-off region.

definition: all that is offered as libation to a deity.
example_en: During the worship, they offered the libation materials to the deity.

definition: a variety of paddy.
example: ಕೊನೆವಾಳೆ ಎಂಬ ಬತ್ತವನ್ನು ಈ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They grow the paddy variety called konevale in this village.

definition: a looking forward to; anticipation; expectation.
example: ಮಗನ ಆಗಮನದ ಇಟ್ಟಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ತಾಯಿ ಬಾಗಿಲ ಬಳಿ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದಳು.
example_en: In anticipation of her son's arrival, the mother stood near the door.

definition: (obs.) a kind of musical instrument.
example: ಆ ಶಾಸನದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಟುಮುಖವಾದಿತ್ರ ಎಂಬ ವಾದ್ಯದ ಉಲ್ಲೇಖವಿದೆ.
example_en: There is a mention of a musical instrument called kaṭumukhavāditra in that inscription.

definition: to expel bad smelling gas, caused by indigestion, through the mouth from the stomach.
example_en: Having eaten stale food, he burped out the foul-smelling gas.

definition: a oblique pavement made for water to flow down.
example: ಮಳೆನೀರು ಹರಿಯಲು ಮನೆಯ ಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಜು ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: They made an oblique water-drain beside the house for the rain water to flow.

definition: an infectious children disease, causing red spots on the skin, fever and continuous mucus discharge through the nose; measles.
example: ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ದಡಾರ ಬಂದು ಮೈತುಂಬ ಕೆಂಪು ಗುಳ್ಳೆಗಳಾದವು.
example_en: The child got measles and red spots appeared all over the body.

definition: a colourless, crystalline compound, potassium nitrate (KNO3), used in gunpowder, medicine, preservative, etc.; saltpetre.
example_en: Saltpetre is used for food preservation.

definition: the quality or condition of being straight; straightness.
example: ಆ ಕೋಲಿನ ಸಾರಳ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗಮನ ಸೆಳೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The straightness of that rod caught everyone's attention.

definition: the early part of the day; morning.
example_en: People go to the temple in the early morning.

definition: a kind of net used by animal-catchers.
example_en: The hunter set the animal-catching net in the forest.

definition: a natural mixture of earth, rock powder, with gold particles (from which gold is extracted).
example_en: They collected the gold-bearing earth on the river bank.

definition: any of the fingers of the hand.
example_en: His finger was burnt by the fire.

definition: the act of giving up anything or everything for the sake of another or others; a great sacriice.
example: ತಾಯಿಯು ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕಡುಚಾಗ ಮಾಡಿ ತನ್ನ ಆಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನೆಲ್ಲ ಬಿಟ್ಟುಕೊಟ್ಟಳು.
example_en: The mother made a great sacrifice for her children and gave up all her property.

definition: the building, room or series of rooms in which the affairs of a business, professional person, branch of government, etc. are carried on; an office.
example_en: Father goes to the office every morning.

definition: a kind of net used to catch sambars.
example_en: The hunters spread a marevale net to catch sambars.

definition: to join a group or mob.
example_en: The protesters joined the mob in the street.

definition: a man distressed, troubled by worry or worries.
example_en: He became a man distressed by the worry of debt.

definition: the tree Ficus gibbosa of Moraceae family; rhomboid fig.
example_en: We rested under the rhomboid fig tree.

definition: promotion - a) advancement in rank, grade or position; b) furtherance of an enterprise.
example_en: He received a promotion at the office.

definition: the common wild duck.
example_en: A wild duck was swimming in the pond.

definition: that which has consciousness; the conscious.
example_en: Philosophy says the soul is the conscious.

definition: a medicine that counters the effect of another medicine.
example_en: They gave a counter-medicine for the poison's effect.

definition: the tree Erythroxylon monogynum of Erythroxylaceae family; red cedar.
example_en: They planted the jivadana (red cedar) tree in the garden.

definition: a kind of delirium characterised by confusion, hallucination etc.
example_en: He developed delirium with confusion and hallucination during the fever.

definition: to be piled up one above the other.
example_en: The gunny sacks were piled up one above the other in the warehouse.

definition: a king; a ruler; a monarch.
example_en: The king of that principality was very famous.

definition: an army or a division of an army.
example_en: The king's army division had encamped on the riverbank.

definition: to give back an image of; to mirror.
example_en: The water mirrored my face.

definition: a small bell usu. fixed to anklets, for its chiming sound.
example_en: The small bell on the dancer's anklet made a chiming sound.

definition: a group of persons animals or things; a multitude; a gathering; a herd.
example_en: A multitude of people had gathered together at the fair.

definition: a brush made of rough bristles with a handle, used for painting walls with lime or paints.
example_en: They whitewashed the wall with the lime brush.

definition: (pl.) the five metals - copper, brass, zinc, lead and iron.
example_en: They made the worship idol from the five metals.

definition: a latticework, having vines grown over; a bower; an arbour.
example_en: There was an arbour behind the palace.

definition: to pay attention; to be attentive; to consider, observe attentively.
example: ಶಿಕ್ಷಕನ ಮಾತಿಗೆ ಚಿತ್ತಗೊಡು ಎಂದು ತಾಯಿ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಹೇಳಿದಳು.
example_en: The mother told her son to pay attention to the teacher's words.

definition: a single or multitude of stray cows.
example_en: The stray cattle in the village ruined the crop.

definition: a pre-eminently mighty man.
example_en: People used to call him the pre-eminently mighty man.

definition: to be criticised, reproached severely; to be subject to harsh criticism or reproach.
example: ಸುಳ್ಳು ಹೇಳಿದ್ದಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲರ ಮುಂದೆ ಜಱಿಗೊಂಡನು.
example_en: For telling a lie, he was severely reproached in front of everyone.

definition: an iniquitous, unjust, wicked fellow.
example: ಆ ಲಫಂಗ ಊರಿನ ಜನರನ್ನು ಸದಾ ಮೋಸಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That wicked scoundrel was always cheating the people of the town.

definition: a male buffalo (Bubalus bubalis).
example_en: The male buffalo was slowly pulling the cart in the field.

definition: to cause to enter or come in.
example_en: They let the light enter into the room.

definition: the most occult, mystic or esoteric knowledge; the knowledge of the Supreme Being.
example_en: He received the most esoteric knowledge from his guru.

definition: a good news.
example_en: The priest preached the good news to the people in the church.

definition: a follower of Śaiva sect.
example_en: Many people of that village were followers of the Śaiva sect.

definition: of a more excellent sort; surpassing another or others; better.
example: ಈ ಬಾರಿಯ ಬೆಳೆ ಕಳೆದ ವರ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಜಾಬಾದವಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: This year's crop is better than last year's.

definition: to go back to original or previous position or place; to retreat.
example_en: The soldiers retreated from the forest.

definition: (mystic.) one of the ten important pulse-points in the human body.
example: ಯೋಗಿಗಳು ದೇಹದ ಒಂದೊಂದು ಅಲಂಬುವಿನ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The yogis discussed each pulse-point of the body.

definition: a crying aloud; the act of one who or that which weeps; weeping.
example_en: Hearing the child's loud crying, the mother came running.

definition: the royal family.
example_en: Members of the royal family took part in that ceremony.

definition: any of the varieties of lotus plants.
example: ಕವಿ ತನ್ನ ಕವನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಳಿನದ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯ ವರ್ಣಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The poet described the beauty of the lotus in his poem.

definition: a stupid, slow-witted person.
example_en: That slow-witted person cannot even understand simple words.

definition: the jackal Canis aureus.
example_en: The jackal was seen at the edge of the field.

definition: a mixture, esp. adulterated one.
example_en: They detected that an adulterated mixture had been mixed into that oil.

definition: a group, clan of hunters.
example_en: That clan of hunters lived within the forest.

definition: to give to; to pass over into another's hand; to hand over.
example_en: He handed over the book to his friend.

definition: the large, somewhat arboreal anthropoid ape, Pan troglodytes, with black hair and large, outstanding ears, hands adapted for knuckle-walking, and is smaller than a gorilla and is noted for its intelligence; chimpanzee.
example: ಚಿಂಪಾಂಜಿಯು ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ಬಾಳೆಯ ಹಣ್ಣನ್ನು ತಿನ್ನುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The chimpanzee was sitting on the tree eating a banana.

definition: the act of succeeding or coming after another in order or sequence; succession.
example_en: In this book the sequence of events has been given.

definition: unobstructed; unrestrained; freely moving or flowing.
example_en: Unobstructed water is flowing in the canal.

definition: a removing or being removed or eliminated; a removal or elimination (of an evil, danger, etc.).
example_en: A quick removal/solution to the problem was found.

definition: the celestial river, Gaŋgā.
example_en: The water of the celestial river Gaŋgā is believed to be sacred.

definition: a contagious infection of the respiratory passages, esp. of the nose and throat, characterised by an acute inflammation of the mucous membranes, nasal discharge, malaise; cold.
example_en: He caught a cold from getting wet in the rain.

definition: deliberate; intentional; wilful.
example: ಅವನು ಉದ್ದಿಶ್ಯಪೂರ್ವಕ ಕೃತ್ಯದಿಂದ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: He caused harm to the institution through a deliberate act.

definition: a man who foretells a future event (under the supposed divine influence); a prophesier.
example: ಆ ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ನುಡಿಗ ಬರಗಾಲದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The village prophesier warned about the coming famine.

definition: to arrange (a troop) to camp at some place.
example_en: The soldiers made the troop camp outside the town.

definition: the act or state of enjoying the possession, use or benefit of something; enjoyment.
example: ಅವನು ತನ್ನ ಸಂಪತ್ತಿನ ಸಂಭೋಗವನ್ನು ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಅನುಭವಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He fully enjoyed the possession of his wealth.

definition: the tube of a gun, through which the projectile is fired; the barrel of a gun.
example_en: The barrel of the gun needed to be cleaned.

definition: to attract; to charm; to interest.
example_en: That picture greatly charmed the children.

definition: revolt against and, forcible resistance to constituted authority; a mutiny.
example_en: A mutiny broke out in the kingdom and the administration fell into disarray.

definition: the most formidable form of Pārvati.
example_en: Devotees worship the formidable form of Parvati with fear.

definition: a kind of physical exercise practiced with a fencing stick in one hand and a sword in the other.
example_en: The soldiers practice sword-and-stick exercise every day.

definition: a person whose profession is to groom a horse or horses.
example: ಅರಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುದುರೆಗಾಱ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಕುದುರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ನಾನ ಮಾಡಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: In the palace the horse-groom used to bathe the horses every day.

definition: an answer or response in speech or writing; a reply.
example: ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆದು ಸೂಳುತ್ತರ ಕಳುಹಿಸು ಎಂದು ಅವನು ಹೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He said to write a letter and send a reply.

definition: the recording of electrical signals by means of changes in areas of magnetisation on a tape, wire or disc, used for recording sound, video material, etc.; magnetic recording.
example_en: He listened to the song on the tape recorder.

definition: a place where goods are sold and bought; a market.
example_en: She sells milk in the market every day.

definition: a list of titles.
example_en: The king's list of titles was inscribed in the record.

definition: an offering of food, meat, etc. to the regents of all the directions or to different demigods.
example: ಗೃಹ ಪ್ರವೇಶದ ಮೊದಲು ದಿಗ್ಬಲಿ ಸಮಾರಂಭ ನಡೆಯಿತು.
example_en: The ceremony of offering to the regents of the directions took place before the housewarming.

definition: a particular mode in fighting (in a battlefield).
example_en: The warriors fought in a particular mode and faced the enemy.

definition: an animal with tusks, esp. an elephant.
example: ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ರದಿ ಆನೆಗಳ ಹಿಂಡು ನೀರು ಕುಡಿಯುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A herd of tusked elephants was drinking water in the forest.

definition: the act of bathing;
example: ಬೆಳಗಿನ ಮೀಹಣ ಮುಗಿಸಿ ಅವನು ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದನು.
example_en: After finishing his morning bath, he went to the temple.

definition: excessive greed.
example_en: His excessive greed did not diminish no matter how much he earned.

definition: totalling seven and a half lakh.
example_en: Seven and a half lakh rupees have been spent on this project.

definition: the helm - a) the wheel or tiller by which a ship or boat is steered; b) the complete steering gear, including the wheel or tiller, rudder, etc.
example_en: An experienced sailor alone must hold the ship's helm.

definition: a food baked from a leavened, kneaded dough made with flour or meal, water, etc.; bread.
example_en: They specially prepared bread for the festival.

definition: the quality of being lusterous; lustre; brilliance.
example_en: There was a special glow on her face.

definition: the superintendent of a kitchen (in a palace).
example_en: The kitchen superintendent gave orders to the cooks.

definition: a slender woman.
example_en: That slender woman walked slowly.

definition: a thick, hard wood.
example_en: The carpenter made a strong cot from thick, hard wood.

definition: pain caused by injury, disease or mental distress.
example_en: The pain of the wound troubled him all night.

definition: to treat with disrespect or indifference; to slight.
example_en: They spoke to the poor man treating him with disrespect.

definition: (in composition) small, little.
example_en: Her tiny fingers were full of bangles.

definition: a head not wearing any headgear.
example_en: Sweat trickled down on the bare head in the sun.

definition: a woman with a curved or hooked nose like a parroṭs beak.
example_en: That girl with the parrot-like hooked nose spoke with a smile.

definition: a training given to a person by a spiritual teacher regarding worshipping of, and the secret of, linga.
example: ಗುರುಗಳು ಶಿಷ್ಯನಿಗೆ ಲಿಂಗಾಯ್ತ ನೀಡಿ ಲಿಂಗಪೂಜೆಯ ರಹಸ್ಯ ತಿಳಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The guru gave the disciple initiation and taught the secret of linga worship.

definition: cancer - a) a malignant new growth anywhere in the body of a person or animal; malignant tumour; b) any of various diseases characterised by the uncontrolled growth of cells that disrupt body tissue.
example: ಆ ರೋಗಿಗೆ ಕ್ಯಾನ್ಸರ್ ಇರುವುದಾಗಿ ವರದಿ ಬಂದಿತು.
example_en: The report showed that the patient had cancer.

definition: the point directly overhead in the sky or on the celestial sphere; the zenith.
example_en: When the sun reached the zenith, the shadow became small.

definition: to wander aimlessly.
example_en: The child was wandering aimlessly around the town.

definition: extreme indulgence of one's appetites, for sexual pleasure; the act or practice of prostituting; prostitution.
example_en: Due to poverty, she had to take to prostitution.

definition: moving; not stationary.
example_en: He leads a moving, non-stationary life.

definition: a person engaged in trade by exchanging goods without using money; a barterer.
example: ಆ ಗೂಱುಮಾಱಾಳಿ ಬಟ್ಟೆಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗಿ ಅಕ್ಕಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟನು.
example_en: That barterer gave rice in exchange for cloth.

definition: a variety in sugarcane.
example_en: Farmers prefer the gabbarasadali variety of sugarcane.

definition: authority; control.
example_en: That officer had authority over the department.

definition: the quality of an honest and truthful person. habitual truthfullness.
example_en: The officer's truthfulness is an example to everyone.

definition: the tendency of, resoluteness in, being truthful; habitual truthfulness.
example_en: Because of his habitual truthfulness, all the villagers trust him.

definition: a nomadic Romany caste.
example_en: People of the Sukali caste used to travel from village to village.

definition: any of a genus (Ocimum) of fragrant plants of the mint family, esp. a white-flowered garden herb (Ocimum sanctum which is religiously regarded as a goddess).
example_en: A holy basil plant has grown in the courtyard.

definition: that can be imagined; imaginable.
example_en: This solution was easily imaginable.

definition: a multitude of bees.
example_en: A swarm of bees was buzzing around that tree.

definition: convergent - a) coming together as if to meet or join; b) (of lines) tending to meet at a point; c) (biol.) (of unrelated organisms) showing a tendency to become similar while evolving to fill a similar ecological niche.
example: ಎರಡು ರಸ್ತೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಏಕಾಗ್ರಮುಖವಾಗಿ ಸೇರುತ್ತವೆ.
example_en: The two roads meet convergently at the same point.

definition: a case for arrows; a quiver.
example_en: The hunter slung his quiver over his shoulder.

definition: want of clarity, purity.
example_en: Lack of clarity was evident in his speech.

definition: to revolve, rotate rapidly on an axis or on the circumference of a circle.
example_en: The children spun around rapidly and played in the field.

definition: a natural pond on a hill or mountain.
example_en: The natural pond on the hill had crystal clear water.

definition: a small chest or box, as for jewels; a casket.
example_en: She had kept the silver vessels in the small box.

definition: a woven, knitted or pressed fabric of fibrous material, as cotton, wool, silk, hair, synthetic fibres, etc. (chiefly used for covering the body).
example_en: Various kinds of fabric are available in the shop.

definition: (dupl. of antara) (pl.) different spaces in between.
example_en: There were narrow lanes in the different spaces between the houses.

definition: the surface of water in a river, sea, etc.
example_en: The fish swim on the surface of the water.

definition: love; affection.
example_en: She spoke to the child with affection.

definition: to amuse; to entertain.
example: ಆ ನರ್ತಕಿ ತನ್ನ ಕುಣಿತದಿಂದ ಲೀಲೆದೋಱಿ ಪ್ರೇಕ್ಷಕರನ್ನು ರಂಜಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The dancer entertained the audience with her graceful dance.

definition: to speak or shout in a shrill voice.
example_en: She shouted in a shrill voice out of fear.

definition: a place where tiffin, meals, beverages, etc. can be bought and eaten; a restaurant.
example: ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣದ ಬಳಿ ಒಂದು ಹೊಟೇಲು ಇದೆ.
example_en: There is a restaurant near the bus stand.

definition: currently sleeping; asleep.
example_en: The baby was in a sleeping state in the cradle.

definition: lack or loss of repute; bad reputation; disgrace; disfavour; disrepute.
example_en: Because he told lies, he earned a bad reputation.

definition: to become wider, broader; to spread oneself over a wide area.
example_en: The smoke from the fire spread across the entire sky.

definition: a sub-caste among Brahmaṇas, followers of Rāmānujā's philosophy.
example: ಅವರ ಐಯಂಗಾರ್ ಕುಟುಂಬವು ಹಳೆಯ ಸಂಪ್ರದಾಯವನ್ನು ಪಾಲಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Their Iyengar family follows the old tradition.

definition: a man who decorates or keeps tidiness.
example_en: The decorator beautifully adorned the wedding hall.

definition: the act of pulling towards.
example_en: The pulling of the creeper needed support for the plant.

definition: (arith. & phys.) a quantity that always has the same value, as opp. to a variable; a constant.
example_en: In mathematics, pi is a well-known constant.

definition: to fall down making a heavy sound.
example: ಆ ಮರ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ದುಡುಮುದು ನೆಲಕ್ಕೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತು.
example_en: That tree fell to the ground with a heavy thud.

definition: a man who leads, guides others; a leader.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರತಿಮುಖರ ತನ್ನ ಬುದ್ಧಿವಂತಿಕೆಯಿಂದ ಜನರನ್ನು ಮುನ್ನಡೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: That leader guided the people with his wisdom.

definition: to stir (a mixture) thoroughly.
example_en: The cook stirred the batter thoroughly.

definition: father of one's grandfather or grandmother; a great grandfather.
example_en: My great-grandfather is still alive.

definition: a small trumpet-like wind instrument.
example_en: The sound of a small trumpet was heard at the festival.

definition: the plant Celosia argenta of Amaranthaceae family, widely used as a green vegetable; cock's comb
example_en: They have grown cock's comb greens in the garden.

definition: Mathurā, the place where Křṣṇa was born.
example_en: The pilgrims went to Mathura, the birthplace of Krishna, with devotion.

definition: the state of being prepared or ready for; readiness.
example_en: His readiness for the journey was complete.

definition: the back or hind part; the backside.
example_en: He got hurt on the backside.

definition: the war that is undertaken.
example_en: The war that was undertaken began between the two kingdoms.

definition: the quality or fact of being very light; lightness.
example_en: The lightness of that cloth suits the summer.

definition: rapidity in moving, going, travelling, proceeding or performing.
example_en: That runner's speed was greater than everyone else's.

definition: to graft - a) to insert (a shoot or bud) as a graft; b) to insert a graft of (one plant) in another.
example: ಅವನು ಗುಲಾಬಿ ಗಿಡಕ್ಕೆ ಬೇರೆ ತಳಿಯ ಕಡ್ಡಿಯನ್ನು ಕಸೆಕಟ್ಟಿದನು.
example_en: He grafted a twig of a different variety onto the rose plant.

definition: tangled hair.
example_en: Her hair had become tangled from not being combed for many days.

definition: a steel tool with a rough, ridged surface for sharpening the teeth of a saw.
example_en: The carpenter sharpened the saw's teeth with the saw-set.

definition: a slender, thin, small or subtle thing.
example_en: He picked up that slender little stick.

definition: (a wound, pain) to get healed from within.
example: ಕೆಲವು ದಿನಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಗಾಯ ತಾನಾಗಿ ಉಳ್ಳಾಱಿತು.
example_en: Within a few days his wound got healed from within on its own.

definition: any foul or filthy substance, as mud, grime, dust or excrement.
example_en: Filthy mud had stuck onto the cloth.

definition: the keen sight of or as of a kite.
example_en: The hunter identified the prey with the keen sight of a kite.

definition: a fierce force; vehemence.
example_en: The bridge was swept away by the fierce force of the flood.

definition: butter clarified by boiling; ghee.
example_en: She brought ghee to light the lamp for worship.

definition: a man addicted or being enslaved to a habit or practice obsessively; an addict.
example_en: The man addicted to gambling lost his house and property.

definition: a clear and fair copy of a manuscript.
example_en: The clerk prepared a fair copy of the agreement.

definition: the act or fact of agreeing, tallying, corresponding (with another thing, statement, etc.); agreement; correspondence.
example: ಎರಡು ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ತಾಳಿಕೆ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was good agreement between the two statements.

definition: a children's amusement, play played with dolls.
example_en: The children were engrossed in doll-play in the evening.

definition: a man who takes care of or protects.
example_en: As a protector, he tends the cows.

definition: a man who loafs; idler; loafer.
example: ಆ ದಿಮ್ಮದಿರುಗ ಇಡೀ ದಿನ ಬೀದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸುತ್ತಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದ.
example_en: That loafer used to wander in the street the whole day.

definition: to give vigour to; to fill with energy; to energise; to add strength to; to invigorate.
example_en: The guru's words invigorated the disciples.

definition: morally bad or wrong path.
example_en: His morally wrong conduct caused trouble to everyone.

definition: the extent, dimensions, capacity, etc. of anything, esp. as determined by a standard.
example: ಈ ಪಾತ್ರೆಯ ಪವಣ ಎಷ್ಟು ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದನು.
example_en: He asked what the capacity of this vessel was.

definition: the sun.
example_en: The sun hid itself in the west.

definition: (one's natural ability of thinking or reasoning) to become impaired.
example_en: His reasoning ability became impaired due to the shock.

definition: a minor pulse crop raised between the two furrows of the main crop.
example: ಬೆಳೆಗಾರ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಬೆಳೆಯ ನಡುವೆ ಅಕ್ಕಡಿಕಾಳು ಬೆಳೆಸಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer raised the minor pulse crop between the rows of the main crop.

definition: the act of painting, writing, drawing pictures, portraits, etc.
example_en: That artist was skilled in the act of painting.

definition: (fig.) one who kills his own kinsmen.
example: ಜನರು ಆ ದ್ರೋಹಿಯನ್ನು ಕರುಳುಗಡಿಕ ಎಂದು ಕರೆದರು.
example_en: People called that traitor a killer of his own kin.

definition: a continuous flow or stream of milk.
example: ಆ ಪುಣ್ಯಕ್ಷೇತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ಷೀರಪ್ರವಾಹ ಹರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಕಥೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The legend says a continuous stream of milk flows at that holy place.

definition: a man who lives in a village; a villager.
example_en: The villager went to the field at dawn.

definition: the act of shaking (a piece of cloth, bag, etc.) vehemently to take the dust out.
example_en: The shaking of the cloth sent all the dust flying out.

definition: a cap made of soft wool.
example: ಚಳಿಗಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನು ಬೆಚ್ಚಗಿನ ಗೋಟೆಯನ್ನು ತಲೆಗೆ ಹಾಕಿಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: In winter, he wore a warm woollen cap on his head.

definition: anything that is remaining; remainder; balance.
example_en: They distributed the remainder of the food to the poor.

definition: a leather sack for carrying water on a bullock.
example: ರೈತನು ಎತ್ತಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಪಖ್ಖಲೆ ಹೊತ್ತು ನೀರು ಸಾಗಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer carried water on the bullock in a leather sack.

definition: to soak rice in water.
example_en: The rice must be soaked in water before cooking.

definition: chastity, virtue of a household-woman.
example_en: Her chastity as a household-woman was a model for the whole village.

definition: a losing or being lost; loss.
example_en: Only loss came out of this transaction.

definition: to carry on a trade or business; to trade.
example_en: He carried on the gold trade in the town.

definition: of or having to do with a nation or the nation; national.
example_en: This is a national festival.

definition: Viṣṇu, who is equipped with the circular missile.
example_en: The devotees praised Viṣṇu, who bears the discus.

definition: the quality or fact of being clean; cleanliness.
example: ಈ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಯ ಪಾಕೀಜಾ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಸಮಾಧಾನ ತಂದಿತು.
example_en: The cleanliness of this hospital gave everyone comfort.

definition: the corner at the far end.
example_en: That book was in the far corner of the cupboard.

definition: elevation or distance above a given level; height.
example_en: The selection of candidates for the election was difficult.

definition: in person; personally.
example_en: He came in person and asked for forgiveness.

definition: a row of closely planted shrubs, bushes or trees forming a boundary or fence; a hedge.
example_en: They have grown a green hedge around the garden.

definition: a woman who is round and plump; a beautiful woman.
example_en: She looked beautiful and plump like a durudumbi.

definition: a body governing a district; a district council.
example: ಜಿಲ್ಲಾಮಂಡಲಿ ರಸ್ತೆ ದುರಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಹಣ ಮಂಜೂರು ಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: The district council sanctioned money for road repairs.

definition: the dead body of a human being or any other animal; corpse.
example_en: Many corpses lay in the battlefield.

definition: to rise into air (as dust).
example_en: When the wind blew, the dry soil rose into the air as dust.

definition: a plant that lives on or in and obtains nutriment from, another plant.
example_en: The parasitic plant lives on another plant.

definition: a perch on which birds, esp. domestic fowls, can rest or sleep; a roost.
example: ಕೋಳಿಗಳು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಕೂಡುಗಂಬಿಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಕುಳಿತು ನಿದ್ರಿಸಿದವು.
example_en: The fowls sat on the roost and slept at night.

definition: any game played with a ball.
example_en: The school children won the ball game.

definition: to make into a bundle; to wrap or tie together; to bundle.
example: ಆ ಪುರಾತನ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿಗಳನ್ನು ಪೊಱೆಗಟ್ಟಿದರು.
example_en: In that ancient poem the soldiers bundled up their supplies.

definition: an unpleasant feeling caused by impending danger, pain etc.; fear.
example: ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ತೀವ್ರ ಆತಂಕ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He felt severe anxiety about the exam results.

definition: to take birth; to be born.
example_en: He was born in this town.

definition: to become as sharp as the blade of scissors.
example_en: The sharpened knife became as sharp as a scissor blade.

definition: a complicated, confuxed condition solving of which is very difficult; complication.
example_en: This case turned into a big complication.

definition: pleased; gladdened.
example: ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಹೆಟ್ಟವಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the good news, his mind became pleased.

definition: a stick used to goad an elephant, horse, ox, etc. into action; a goad.
example_en: The mahout drove the elephant forward with the goad.

definition: the condition of requiring, wanting something; necessity.
example_en: There is urgent necessity for this work.

definition: the quality of being genial or jovial; joviality; geniality.
example_en: His joviality pleased everyone.

definition: destruction of the opposition side or hostile enemy.
example: ಸೇನೆಯು ಶತ್ರುಪಡೆಯ ವಿಪಕ್ಷಪಾತ ಮಾಡಿ ವಿಜಯ ಸಾಧಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The army achieved victory by destroying the enemy's opposing forces.

definition: a mixed gas obtained by passing steam and air over incandescent coke or other source of carbon; semi-water gas.
example_en: They produce semi-water gas in the factory.

definition: the vine Cucumis melo ( = C. aromatics, = C. utilissimus) of Cucurbitaceae family; musk melon plant.
example_en: The musk melon vine has grown green in the garden.

definition: a piece of land unsuitable for vegetation.
example: ಆ ಜಾಗ ಈರಿಣವಾಗಿ ಯಾವ ಬೆಳೆಯೂ ಬೆಳೆಯುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: That place is barren land where no crop grows.

definition: a pious man who never swerves from the righteous path.
example_en: That righteous man never told a lie.

definition: a fence, wall of low height, etc. enclosing a building.
example_en: A high enclosing wall was built around the temple.

definition: to make a bumbling, buzzing sound.
example_en: A machine was making a bumbling buzzing sound in the distance.

definition: dark-blue.
example_en: Dark-blue coloured clouds had covered the sky.

definition: existence - a) the state or fact of being; b) continuance of being; life; living.
example_en: His existence passed in poverty itself.

definition: to move one's brow or brows to expresss one's feelings or to convey something.
example_en: She raised her brow and looked questioningly.

definition: a flat, wide, plate made intertwining thin bamboo splits.
example_en: She spread the papads on the flat bamboo plate.

definition: lacking in positive character or quality; negative.
example: ಅವನ ಮಾತು ನಾತ್ಮಕವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಯಾವ ಪ್ರಯೋಜನವೂ ಇಲ್ಲ.
example_en: His words are negative and of no use.

definition: the state or fact of being incomplete; incompleteness.
example_en: The incompleteness in his essay is clear.

definition: a house that is easily susceptible to fire; a combustible house.
example_en: The fire spread quickly in the combustible house.

definition: flaming fire forming an inaccessible blockade; a fire-barrier.
example: ಶತ್ರುಗಳ ಪಾಲಿಗೆ ಆ ಬೆಟ್ಟ ಕಿಚ್ಚುಗೋಂಟೆಯಾಗಿ ನಿಂತಿತು.
example_en: That hill stood as a flaming fire-barrier for the enemies.

definition: (in comp.) a girl or woman.
example_en: The girl sang well from a young age.

definition: a student of the same class; a classmate.
example: ನನ್ನ ಸಹಪಾಠಿ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತಮ ಅಂಕ ಗಳಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: My classmate scored good marks in the exam.

definition: a single group.
example: ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸೇರಿ ಒಂದು ಒರ್ಬಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone joined together and worked as a single group.

definition: a stupid woman.
example: ಜ್ಞಾನಹೀನೆ ತನ್ನ ಮಗನಿಗೆ ಪಾಠ ಹೇಳಲು ಸಾಧ್ಯವಾಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: The ignorant woman could not teach her son his lesson.

definition: to speak, utter or talk.
example_en: The poet spoke out lamenting his sorrow.

definition: (poetry) sweet lip.
example_en: Her sweet lip is described in the poet's verse.

definition: to fall on the back of.
example_en: The child slipped and fell on its mother's back.

definition: the medium sized, evergreen tree Diospyros peregrina (= D. embryopteris, = D. glutenifera) of Ebenaceae family, the fruits of which contain tannin.
example_en: The Diospyros peregrina tree grows as an evergreen.

definition: name of a tribe mostly living in forests.
example_en: People of the Kattiga tribe live at the edge of the forest.

definition: to cause to wake from or as from sleep.
example_en: She woke him up from sleep.

definition: a man having a keen vision.
example: ಆ ವಿಚಕ್ಷಣ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ವಿಷಯಗಳನ್ನೂ ಸುಲಭವಾಗಿ ಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That perceptive man grasped even subtle matters easily.

definition: an upper-storey in a building.
example_en: The children's room is on the upper storey of the house.

definition: with a gulping sound.
example_en: He drank the water with a gulping sound.

definition: disappointed; frustrated; unsatisfied.
example_en: Having failed the exam, he became disappointed and frustrated.

definition: a person in the business of manufacturing; a factory owner; a manufacturer.
example_en: That factory owner established a new unit.

definition: a woman who spends possessions or money extravagantly or wastefully; prodigal; a spendthrift.
example_en: The spendthrift woman squandered all her property.

definition: to look staringly, without blinking eyes, from anger or jealosy.
example_en: Out of jealousy, she glared at me without blinking.

definition: a twinkling star.
example_en: The twinkling star was shining brightly in the sky.

definition: the area or region adjacent to a farm-land or plantation.
example_en: There was a small pond in the area adjacent to the farm.

definition: the state or quality of being gay; gaiety; cheerfulness.
example: ಆ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾತ್ರೆಯ ದಿಂಗು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಇಷ್ಟವಾಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: Everyone in that village liked the gaiety of the fair.

definition: (a part of the body) to have a bruise (as from a heavy blow).
example_en: From the blow he received, his leg became bruised.

definition: a kind of regulated vibration produced while singing, with closed mouth.
example: ಆಕೆ ಹಾಡುವಾಗ ಬಾಯಿ ಮುಚ್ಚಿ ಮುದ್ರಿತ ಶಬ್ದ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: While singing, she made a hummed sound with her mouth closed.

definition: a person who fishes for a living.
example: ಕೀಲಿಗನು ಮುಂಜಾನೆಯೇ ಬಲೆ ಹಿಡಿದು ಮೀನು ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಹೋದನು.
example_en: The fisherman took his net at dawn and went to catch fish.

definition: to include; to contain.
example_en: This book includes many topics.

definition: the act of applying light touches or strokes to (a person or part of a person's body) so as to excite the nerves and usu. produce laughter and spasmodic movement; tickle; a tickling.
example_en: The little girl laughed loudly at the tickle.

definition: a theatre expressly designed for dance presentations.
example_en: The artists gave a performance in the dance theatre.

definition: any of various herbivorous animals.
example_en: The herbivorous animals were grazing on grass.

definition: a detective - a) a man on a police force, whose work is investigating and trying to solve crimes; b) a man working privately to investigate crimes, gather information, etc.
example: ಪೊಲೀಸ್ ಇಲಾಖೆ ಒಬ್ಬ ಜಾಸೂದನನ್ನು ಪ್ರಕರಣಕ್ಕೆ ನೇಮಿಸಿತು.
example_en: The police department appointed a detective to the case.

definition: a revealing and evading; a partial revelation of fact.
example_en: A partial revelation of fact was evident in her words.

definition: any of the portions of time into which a school day is divided; a period.
example_en: The mathematics lesson took place in the first period.

definition: a stream which is not full.
example_en: In summer that half-empty stream almost dries up.

definition: a great swelling wave of the sea; a billow.
example_en: The great swelling wave of the sea rocked the boat.

definition: the condition of being loose, baggy.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯ ಬೞಲು ಕಂಡು ಅವನು ಅದನ್ನು ಬಿಸಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: Seeing the bagginess of the old cloth, he threw it away.

definition: a structure with a small opening on one side, and a chimney for the smoke to go out, used for baking bread, biscuits, etc.; a bakery-oven.
example_en: Fresh bread was baked in the bakery-oven.

definition: a variety in cardamom plant.
example_en: The fragrance of the gupthagandhi cardamom plant is very sharp.

definition: the part of the face in humans hat contains the nostrils and the organs of smell and functions as the usual passage for air in respiration, formed of bone and cartilage, serving also to modify or modulate the voice or a part corresponding to this in animals; the nose.
example_en: His nose was running because of a cold.

definition: the chief of a battalion or regiment.
example_en: The regiment chief obeyed the king's command.

definition: an arrow with a fire-head; a fiery missile.
example_en: The enemies shot a fiery arrow at the fort.

definition: a woman whose affection, interest, loyalty, etc. are changeable or unstable; a fickle-minded woman.
example_en: Everyone says she is a fickle-minded woman.

definition: a hard, crystalline or granular, metamorphic limestone, white or variously coloured and sometimes streaked or mottled, which can take a high polish; the marble.
example_en: The statue has been carved from marble.

definition: wage paid in the form of grains (instead of money) for work done.
example_en: The wage was given to the labourers in the form of grains.
